meta.name: dynamic-content-personalizer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "personalize the email", "add merge tags / dynamic content", "set up conditional blocks per segment", or "make first-name and product-recommendation fields fall back safely"; produces a merge-tag map with per-tag fallbacks, conditional-block rules with per-segment variations, a fallback-safety audit, and a PII guard on what may render, informing the SEND E (Engagement/personalization) dimension. Not for building the segments — use list-segment-builder; not for writing the base copy — use email-creative-builder; not for scoring EQS or running vetoes — use email-quality-auditor. 邮件个性化/合并标签/条件内容块/兜底默认值

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为邮件添加个性化合并标签和条件内容块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在邮件中按用户属性动态显示不同内容
copy.tagline_en: Add personalized merge tags and conditional content blocks to emails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dynamically show different content in emails based on user attributes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为已有的邮件文案添加个性化层：生成合并标签映射（每个标签带兜底值）、按用户分组的条件内容块规则、兜底安全审计（确保没有空字段渲染），以及 PII 防护（哪些字段允许显示）。
howto.when: 当用户要求“个性化邮件”、“添加合并标签/动态内容”、“按分组设置条件块”或“让名字和产品推荐字段安全兜底”时触发。

say.text: 给这封邮件添加合并标签，兜底值用“there”。
say.note: Claude 会生成标签映射和兜底值。

say.text: 设置条件块：VIP 用户看到专属优惠，其他用户看到默认内容。
say.note: Claude 会按分组定义条件规则。

say.text: 审计这个模板的兜底安全和 PII 暴露。
say.note: Claude 会检查空字段和敏感信息。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude adds a personalization layer to an existing email creative: generates a merge-tag map with per-tag fallbacks, conditional-block rules per segment, a fallback-safety audit ensuring no empty field renders, and a PII guard on which fields may appear.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "personalize the email", "add merge tags / dynamic content", "set up conditional blocks per segment", or "make first-name and product-recommendation fields fall back safely".

say_en.text: Add merge tags with fallbacks to this email, fallback to 'there'.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a tag map and fallback values.

say_en.text: Set up conditional blocks: VIPs see exclusive offer, others see default.
Audit this template for fallback safety and PII exposure.
say_en.note: Claude will check for empty fields and sensitive data.
